formattedAddress: No. 1號, Lane 29, Section 2, Guiyang St, 萬華區 Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108007

text.text:
A charming little shop with a great atmosphere, perfect for small gatherings.

Regarding the food: The Creamy Dory Fish with White Sauce ($200) had a perfect consistency—the white sauce was neither too thick nor too thin, and the rice was cooked to the ideal firmness. It was a shame the presentation lacked color; otherwise, it would have been a feast for the eyes, nose, and palate.

The fries were freshly made and incredibly crispy, a wonderful snack.

The black tea was just the right strength.

Unfortunately, the kitchen staff missed their order and it wasn't in the order of preparation. We waited about 1.5 hours for our food, and without inquiring, the kitchen staff probably wouldn't have followed up, resulting in everyone working independently. The methods for checking and responding to each other's orders could be improved to prevent similar situations from happening again.

originalText.text:
很有氛圍感的小店，很適合小聚會
餐飲方面
白醬奶油多利魚（$200），白醬濃稠度適中，不會過度濃稠或稀釋，米飯上的軟硬度也相當合適入口，就是可惜在擺盤上少了些色彩，不然可說是色香味俱全。
薯條剛出鍋的，非常酥脆，當點心非常棒
紅茶濃度剛好。

只是剛好碰上內場把點餐訂單掉落而沒在製作的序列中，等了約1.5個小時才取得餐點，而且如果沒有詢問，可能外場不會再去追問內場，而成各自努力的狀態。內外場相互的再確認與即時掌握方式可能可以再看怎麼加強，以防再有如此意外的狀況。

text.text:
I stumbled upon this little shop tucked away in an alley by chance. The owner's warm welcome made me agree to become a customer.

The shop was brightly lit. The decor was retro, with many old-fashioned items on display. The boxy TV was particularly cool – it actually worked!

For the Ximending area, the prices were incredibly affordable, and the quality of the food was beyond my expectations. Many restaurants name their dishes exactly what they say – "Bacon" – meaning only noodles and bacon. But not here. My "Basil Garlic Bacon" dish included more than just bacon; it also had various mushrooms. This was a huge plus.

As for the taste, I personally thought it was fantastic, incredibly delicious. The noodles were very chewy, and the stir-fried seasoning was just right – the owner even said it wasn't too salty, and there were many condiments to add yourself. What I found most unique was the "choose your spiciness level for the stir-fry." The restaurant even includes a special note on how many chili peppers you want in your spiciness selection. In all my years, this is the first time I've ever seen a restaurant make such a note.

Overall, based solely on the "owner's service," the "restaurant's ambiance," and the "food," I highly recommend it! As for other aspects like waiting times and delivery, I'm not so familiar with those. However, judging from how I observed the owner today and her responses to every review, I believe she takes this restaurant very seriously and puts her heart into it.

If you happen to stumble upon this restaurant, discover it, or even start scrolling through the reviews and end up reading this, I sincerely hope you'll give this little shop a chance. I don't think you'll be disappointed!

originalText.text:
因緣際會知道這間位於巷弄的小店。同時因為老闆娘的熱情招呼，讓我願意成為其中的顧客之一。
店裡的光線很明亮。裝潢不但是走復古風，還擺設許多古早時候的物品。尤其是那台箱型電視，竟然還能播放，真的是很酷。
以西門町周邊地段來說，這裡除了價格非常平易近人以外，餐點的品質與水準簡直超乎想像。許多店家的餐點名稱，配料就如同餐點名字一樣。例如「培根」，整盤麵就只會有麵條跟培根而已。然而這裡不是如此。像是我點購的「塔香蒜味培根」。配料可不只是只有培根，還有許多菇類。這點無疑是超級大加分。
味道的部分，我個人認為非常棒，非常好吃。麵條相當有嚼勁，清炒的調味，老闆娘還會說沒有炒得很鹹，有許多調味料可以自行添加。其中我覺得最為特別的是「清炒的辣度選擇」。店家的辣度選擇還特別備註「幾根朝天椒」。我活了這麼久，還是第一次看到有店家會這麼備註。
總體而言，若是單純以「老闆娘的服務態度」、「店家的內用環境」與「餐點」而言，我個人非常大力推薦！至於排隊等候與外送等等其他評論，我就不是很清楚了。然而以我今天看待老闆娘的樣子，以及老闆娘對於每一則評論的回覆，我相信老闆娘對於這間店非常認真且用心地看待。
如果有緣路過這間店，有緣發現到這間店，有緣思考要不要去這間店開始滑著評論區而看到我這則評論的人，誠心希望能給這間小店一次機會。我認為不會讓人失望的！

text.text:
The food was okay, the taste was average, but the portions were generous.

Both men and women were very full!

⭐️100 points for the male staff member serving us!
He was incredibly friendly and hands-on.
His diligent attitude deserves applause!👏🏻

The customers were generally not very polite; they were all quite noisy.
Today, the table next to us was noisy, and the tables behind us were noisy too.

That girl said she hadn't taken the plate because of static electricity while asking for it back?

She actually dropped and broke the plate during the handover, making a huge bang! The staff didn't know if they asked her to pay for it; they were totally dumbfounded.🙄

Thank you to the hardworking male staff member!

I feel sorry for him.😓 You're great; I only saw you working by yourself.
